He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Cal State Fullerton Titans men's basketball|Cal State Fullerton Titans]]. ==High school career== Rowe attended [[Wasatch Academy]] at [[Mount Pleasant, Utah]], where he averaged 15.5 points, 10.2 rebounds, 3.4 steals and 2.1 blocks per game while shooting 71.4 percent from the floor. He helped the Tigers to a 29–4 overall record and No. 14 rating in the final USA Today Super 25 Expert Rankings and was named the Boys' Basketball Mid-Utah Radio Defensive Player of the Year.{{cite web|title=Jackson Rowe - MEN'S BASKETBALL|url=https://fullertontitans.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jackson-rowe/2091|website=FullertonTitans.com|access-date=September 15, 2024}} ==College career== Rowe attended [[Cal State Fullerton Titans men's basketball|Cal State Fullerton]] where he played four years and averaged 15.6 points and 7.4 rebounds per game in 20 games, leading the team in the first two categories which earned him second-team All-[[Big West Conference|Big West]] honors. Throughout his career, he tallied 21 double-doubles, fourth in school's history and was second rebounds with 811 and blocks with 113.{{cite web|title=Ottawa BlackJacks Re-sign National Team Forward Jackson Rowe|url=https://www.cebl.ca/ottawa-blackjacks-re-sign-national-team-forward-jackson-rowe|website=CEBL.ca|date=March 14, 2023|access-date=September 15, 2024}} ==Professional career== ===Chorale Roanne (2020–2021)=== On May 5, 2020, Rowe signed his first professional contract with [[Chorale Roanne Basket|Chorale Roanne]] of the French [[LNB Élite|LNB Pro A]]{{cite web|first=Adam|last=Maldonado|title=Jackson Rowe continues his basketball career in France|url=https://dailytitan.com/sports/mens-basketball/jackson-rowe-continues-his-basketball-career-in-france/article_cb5fd0eb-7b31-515c-bfce-c708e26f30ec.html|website=DailyTitan.com|date=May 5, 2020|access-date=September 15, 2024}} where he played six games and averaged 5.0 points, 2.0 rebounds, 0.3 assists, 0.3 steals and 0.3 blocks in 12.2 minutes per game.{{cite web|title=Jackson Rowe Player profile|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Jackson-Rowe/Summary/112877|website=RealGM.com|access-date=September 15, 2024}} Later that year, he went undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]]. ===Norrköping Dolphins (2021–2022)=== On July 17, 2021, Rowe signed with the [[Norrköping Dolphins]] of the [[Swedish Basketball League]]{{cite web|author=Norrköping Dolphins|title=WELCOME JACKSON ROWE! 🇺🇸🔥 Norrköping Dolphins värvar den kanadensiske forwarden Jackson Rowe, som senast spelade för Chorale Roanne i den franska högstaligan. #förNorrköping #dolphinsbasket #SBL #basketse|url=https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=951683458964002|website=Facebook.com|date=July 17, 2021|access-date=September 15, 2024|language=Swedish}} where he played 28 games and averaged 16.5 points and 7.2 rebounds per game while recording five double-doubles and scoring 20 or more points eleven times while helping the Dolphins to win a championship.{{cite web|title=🏆 NORRKÖPING DOLPHINS ÄR SVENSKA MÄSTARE 🏆|url=https://www.sblherr.se/article/szywal2ye-3ne1d/view|website=SBLHerr.se|date=May 9, 2022|access-date=September 21, 2024|language=Swedish}} ===Ottawa BlackJacks (2023)=== On March 2, 2022, Rowe signed with the [[Ottawa BlackJacks]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]]{{cite web|title=Ottawa BlackJacks Sign Canadian Forward Jackson Rowe|url=https://www.theblackjacks.ca/ottawa-blackjacks-sign-canadian-forward-jackson-rowe|website=TheBlackJacks.ca|date=March 2, 2022|access-date=September 15, 2024}} where he played 13 games and averaged 9.4 points, 6.2 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 0.6 steals and 1.1 blocks in 24.8 minutes per game. ===medi bayreuth (2022–2023)=== On July 4, 2022, Rowe signed with [[Medi Bayreuth|medi bayreuth]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]],{{cite web|title=Mit Jackson Rowe hat medi bayreuth einen weiteren Kanadier im Team für die neue Saison|url=https://www.bbc-bayreuth.de/news/detailansicht/mit-jackson-rowe-hat-medi-bayreuth-einen-weiteren-kanadier-im-team-fuer-die-neue-saison|website=BBC-Bayreuth.de|date=July 4, 2022|access-date=September 15, 2024|language=German}} where he played 31 league games and averaged 10.8 points, 5.3 rebounds, 2.2 assists, 1.2 steals and 0.8 blocks in 27.1 minutes per game. ===Return to Ottawa (2023)=== On March 14, 2023, Rowe re-signed with the [[Ottawa BlackJacks]] and in 18 games, he averaged 15.3 points, 6.6 rebounds, 1.9 assists, 0.6 steals and 0.4 blocks in 27.7 minutes per game. ===Santa Cruz Warriors (2023–2024)=== On October 30, 2023, Rowe joined the [[Santa Cruz Warriors]] after a tryout.{{cite web|title=Santa Cruz Warriors Announce 2023 Training Camp Roster|url=https://santacruz.gleague.nba.com/news/santa-cruz-warriors-announce-2023-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=September 15, 2024}} In 49 games, he averaged 12.4 points, 6.3 rebounds, 2.2 assists, 1.1 blocks and 1.2 steals in 30 minutes per game.{{cite web|title=Scarborough Shooting Stars Sign Jackson Rowe|url=https://www.scarboroughshootingstars.ca/scarborough-shooting-stars-sign-jackson-rowe|website=ScarboroughShootingStars.ca|date=May 3, 2024|access-date=September 15, 2024}} ===Scarborough Shooting Stars (2024)=== On May 3, 2024, Rowe signed with the [[Scarborough Shooting Stars]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]], playing nine games and averaging 14.9 points, 7.7 rebounds, 2.9 assists, 1.8 steals and 0.6 blocks in 30.3 minutes per game. ===Golden State Warriors / Return to Santa Cruz (2024–2025)=== After joining them for the [[2024 NBA Summer League]],{{cite web|title=Warriors Announce 2024 Summer League Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/warriors-announce-2024-summer-league-roster-20240630|website=NBA.com|date=June 30, 2024|access-date=September 15, 2024}} Rowe signed with the [[Golden State Warriors]] on July 19, 2024,{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Spurs Add Minix, Warriors Sign Rowe On Camp Deals|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/07/spurs-add-minix-warriors-sign-rowe-on-camp-deals.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=July 21, 2024|access-date=September 15, 2024}} but was waived on October 19.{{cite web|title=Warriors Waive Blake Hinson, Kevin Knox II & Jackson Rowe|url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/blake-hinson-kevin-knox-ii-jackson-rowe-waived-20241019|website=NBA.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 22, 2024}} On October 28, he rejoined the [[Santa Cruz Warriors]]{{cite web|title=Santa Cruz Warriors Announce 2024 Training Camp Roster|url=https://santacruz.gleague.nba.com/news/santa-cruz-warriors-announce-2024-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=November 1, 2024}} and on January 28, 2025, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with Golden State.{{cite web|title=Warriors Sign Jackson Rowe to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/jackson-rowe-signs-two-way-contract-20250128|website=NBA.com|date=January 28, 2025|access-date=January 28, 2025}} Rowe did not make any appearances for the Warriors during the [[2025–26 Golden State Warriors season|2025–26 season]]. He was waived by Golden State following the signing of [[LJ Cryer]] on December 1, 2025.{{cite web |date=2025-12-01 |title=Warriors Waive Jackson Rowe |url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/warriors-waive-jackson-rowe-20251201 |access-date=2025-12-06 |website=NBA}} ===Ironi Ness Ziona (2025–present)=== On December 17, 2025, Rowe signed with [[Ironi Ness Ziona B.C.|Ironi Ness Ziona]] of the Israeli [[Israeli Basketball Premier League|Ligat HaAl]].{{cite web |title=Ironi Ness Ziona officially signs Jackson Rowe |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/ironi-ness-ziona-officially-signs-jackson-rowe/ |website=Sportando |access-date=December 19, 2025 |date=December 17, 2025}} ==National team career== Rowe made his debut with the [[Canada men's national basketball team]] in the FIBA World Cup 2023 Americas Qualifiers in February 2023, where he averaged 10.0 points, 5.0 rebounds and 1.5 assists per game in two
